description: This file defines the ConnectorHtmlHelper class, which provides methods to generate HTML snippets for connector interface elements in a web application, including buttons and popups for data sources, utilizing other classes like FormatterFactory and SourceFactory.

classes.name: ConnectorHtmlHelper
classes.description: Helper class for generating HTML code related to connectors in the SuiteCRM platform, including buttons and popup menus for connecting data sources.

methods.name: getConnectorButtonCode
methods.description: Generates HTML code for the hover link field, creating connector buttons with icons and associated JavaScript behavior.

methods.name: getButton
methods.description: Private method to generate HTML button elements for each source, with icons and JavaScript event handlers.

methods.name: getPopup
methods.description: Private method that produces the HTML for a popup menu containing multiple source options, with appropriate icons and JavaScript for interaction.
